title: A posted review record is read back and must parse
why: Lane resume-finished-reviewer-no-tree ([ended:lane:-resume-finished-reviewer-no-tree]): it put notes after the CI: line in three review records (two on #1917, one on #1974); they did not parse, and merge --fix-check refused later. Nothing checked them when posted.
note: Filed 10:29 CST Nov 8 from that lane. Fix: merge --review-record prints that notes go below ---, and reads back each posted record through parse_review. Related: review-record-from-render (doing), record-after-each-round (doing). Two superseded malformed records stay on #1917 (heads 0e32564e8, 4872fb8e4). Folded 10:31 CST Nov 8 (lane comment-check-scans-shell, [ended:lane:-comment-check-scans-shell]): parse_review (merge/merge.py near 3220) returns None when prose sits between the CI: line and ---, and says nothing. Hits: #1909 comment 6720811601 made the Stop hook's record guard say #1909 had no record (a false alarm); runner 8's #1834 record 6719312457 makes --fix-check refuse with a message about the Head that never says the record did not parse. Fix adds: the refusal and the guard name the comment that failed to parse and the line that broke it. Sighting (lane timing-tests, [ended:lane:-timing-tests], 11:15 CST Nov 8): 5 review records on #2086, #2132 and #2143 held prose after the `CI:` line and before `---`, so merge.py parse_review read no record; found only when `--fix-check` refused; fixed by editing the comments. Proposed guard: refuse a comment post whose body starts with `<!-- review-record -->` when parse_review returns None, naming the first bad line. Third sighting (lane other-checkout-cp-own, 11:29 CST Nov 8): 8 review records with notes between the CI line and `---` parsed as None in merge/merge.py parse_review (~line 3193); fixed by editing. Proposed guard: a PreToolUse check on a GitHub comment whose first line is the review-record marker refuses it when parse_review returns None; the remedy says to put notes below `---`. Coordinator 11:31 CST Nov 8: lane since 11:16 CST; it found the post guard already on the stack from #1722 to #2161, and narrowed its scope. Folded into step review-record-parse-warn (coordinator, 16:22 CST Nov 8). This lane sends what it has built to lane [ended:lane:-review-record-parse-warn]. Correction 16:25 CST: this step was set done too early. Its lane holds PR #2219 at ad4fe7b67 (merges after #2161, done record 6726227616). It already makes `--reviewed` name the first line that fails, but not the comment id, and has no lane-lint part. The step stays ready until #2219 merges.
